title: Watch movement on the bench
label: Watch movement in a knurled holder: perlage plate, four screwed clamps, striped barrel bridge with ratchet and crown wheels, Y train bridge over skeleton gears, pallet fork, balance under its cock, knurled crown.
caption: The balance sets the beat. Each swing tips the pallet fork, which lets the escape wheel advance half a tooth, so the mainspring's power leaves the barrel in eighths of a second. Drag across the figure to step through one beat at 1/20 speed.
